**Kit link**
In the configurator, click Copy link and paste it here.

**Printer and slicer**

**Material, walls and infill**

**What happened**
What you did, what you expected and what you got. If a part broke, say where it broke and what load it had.

**Photos**
A photo of the part, and of the face that was on the print bed, helps a lot.
